files.notes: Signed position-risk JSON; absolute quantity and lowercase side; unchecked string assertions on required price/leverage fields can panic. Margin-change failures mostly log and return nil; leverage errors propagate.

Cached wallet/available/unrealized balances. Income-derived GetTrades has no fill quantity, price, fee or side; GetClosedPnL nevertheless wraps those missing values. Per-symbol/from-ID SDK trade reads carry actual fill detail. Commission/PnL symbol discovery each capped at 1000 without pagination.

Hedge-mode market entry/close and Algo SL/TP; quantity-zero close reads signed positions. Opens cancel all symbol orders before validation. Selective cancel list errors omitted; bulk cancellation always nil. Grid placement ignores ReduceOnly, PositionSide, PostOnly and requested ClientID. Protection uses ClosePosition(true), ignoring requested quantity.

Caches signed position quantity. Margin mode mostly fail-open, leverage reads cached positions and sleeps five seconds after update. Sizing helper is margin allocation, not stop-risk. Hardcoded minimum notional 10. Decimal formatting uses rounding/fallback rather than authoritative step-multiple validation.

Constructor sets one-way account mode via POST and logs failure. HMAC/base64 signed V2 transport unwraps Data with 30-second timeout; manual GET query assembly lacks URL encoding. 15-second account caches, five-minute contract cache with shared timestamp; FormatQuantity rounds decimals and defaults to four.

USDT-FUTURES cross-margin requests; market acknowledgement returned as FILLED, closes reduceOnly YES. Plan placement and cancellation paths; individual cancel errors discarded. GetOpenOrders merges ordinary/plan snapshots and swallows failed reads. Limit path honors ReduceOnly but not PostOnly or ClientID.
15-second positions cache; absolute amount, lower side, numeric prices/time. History limited 100, converts fees and milliseconds; lacks record IDs/pagination.

Raw mainnet HMAC execution list through DefaultClient, no timeout or cursor. closedSize decides action; whole execution assigned one action even reversal. 24h sync sorts milliseconds, creates order/fill/position separately, existing order skips all repair; ticker has no stop.

Mainnet SDK constructor adds Referer header, not API key. Qty step public GET with no timeout; permanent cache and fallback step 1. FormatQuantity floors to step. SDK acknowledgement parser returns NEW.

Latest max-100 fills locally filtered by start time, signed size/closeSize determine action. Quanto multiplier defaults to 1 on lookup failure. Sync uses trade-ID orders and separate writes; existing close trades replay into PositionBuilder without idempotency token enforcement here. No ticker shutdown.

USDT futures SDK. Base quantity divided by quanto then integer truncation; <=0 forced to one contract. Reduce-only closes; all market acks labeled FILLED. Margin setter is no-op, leverage risk-limit rejection becomes nil. Selective cancel ignores orderType; trigger classification ignores short direction. Open-order quantity uses multiplier fallback 1.
24h user fills sorted and written as separate order/fill/PositionBuilder updates; trade-ID dedup prevents later repair after order insertion. Synthetic MARKET/maker=false fields. Unstoppable ticker.

Combines spot USDC, perp summary and XYZ equity with partial auxiliary-read failures ignored. XYZ HTTP always mainnet; SDK calls use configured exchange. Status read error/absence returns FILLED with zero fill data. User fills Dir parsing and PnL fallback; zero-PnL closes omitted by GetClosedPnL. GetOpenOrders compares raw coin to input unlike other methods.

Perp and XYZ positions normalized separately; absolute amounts, pointer-safe optional prices; XYZ failure returns partial success. Margin mode is mutable trader-wide local bool consumed by leverage update.

Spot IDR balance and synthetic holdings: total equity counts IDR only, not valued crypto. Position entry equals current mark, unrealized zero; mark lookup errors ignored. ClosedPnL fetches only btc_idr and emits both buys/sells without quantity/entry/PnL; parse failure becomes nil success.

Single-page max100 fills and recent fills; nanosecond timestamps, multiplier fallback BTC .001/other .01, positive close fee decides closing. Sorted sync separate writes, trade-ID skip on replay, no ticker shutdown. ToTradeRecord preserves parsed action.

30-second signed futures transport with server-time offset and HMAC passphrase/partner. Timestamp failure resyncs but does not retry original request. Symbol conversion case-sensitive, not idempotent. Metadata cache all contracts five minutes. Quantity rounds lots and caps maximum, ignores lot-size/minimum.
Cached USDT account overview; margin balance as wallet, explicit AccountEquity aliases avoid wallet-plus-PnL reconstruction.
Open nonzero positions, sign to lower side/absolute base quantity; missing multiplier defaults .001 for every symbol, missing leverage defaults 10. Cache plus explicit invalidation.

Stop wrappers to CreateStopOrder, auth/query order reads, SDK cancellation. Query errors return error in GetOrderStatus, but numeric fields remain strings. SL/TP selective cancel routes to all active orders; individual failure logged then nil. uint16 market index narrowed to uint8. Active-order URL debug log may include auth prefix.

SDK signed market/limit/protective transactions, multipart sendTx, local precision/market cache. Submission distinct internally but wrappers fabricate FILLED. pollForOrderIndex ignores txHash and takes max index. Normalize strips USDT before /USDT causing slash leftovers; lowercase suffix not stripped. 5% market/trigger execution band, 7d limit/30d stop expiry. Leverage always cross, margin setter defaults 10x on position read failure.

JSON DTOs with string numeric order fields and trade position-before fields. parseFloat accepts empty as zero. Checksum uses Keccak nibble casing with only length validation; no hexadecimal validation and uppercase 0X prefix unsupported.

Balance labels totalEq as wallet without totalEquity key; consumer adds UPL again. Local margin setting applied to requests; leverage failures swallowed. ClosedPnL incorrectly expects response envelope after doRequest unwrapped Data; quantity would remain contracts.

Hedge-style opens, mode-aware closes read fresh positions and cap quantity, but net-mode closes lack reduceOnly. ID/sCode acknowledgement labeled FILLED. Stops and cancels ignore item-level sCode accepted by transport. Selective algo cancellation ignores requested type. Open-order reads swallow errors and quantities stay contracts; synthetic _sl/_tp IDs need routing before cancellation.

Positions convert ctVal to base quantity when available; net negative position mislabeled long because only posSide short controls side. Metadata failure leaves contract units. Shared timestamp instrument cache; explicit position invalidation.
Shared 19-method and GridTrader contracts; selective cancellation semantics and numeric map consumers.
Data unwrapping, account simulated flag, naming and decimal formatting; relevant dependency excerpts only.
Config exchange constructor selection and exchange-specific sync startup; NT8 is separate branch.
Equity fallback and status float64 consumers; NT close event separate.
ProcessTrade action routing and close mutation show no per-trade dedup in observed path.
